what: Overlapping panels (photo + text) swap every 5.2 seconds. The incoming panel waits 4% to the right, transparent, then fades in over .52s (cubic-bezier(.455,.03,.515,.955)) while sliding into place (cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,.94)), and once fully visible the outgoing panel is hidden. At the same moment the paired panel (a picture carrying the panel number, like a store marker on a map) switches instantly, and of the 6px square dots in the corner, the one for the current panel lights in the accent color. Dots can be clicked and panels swiped by finger

options.[data-fx-part=stage] > [data-fx-part=sli: Panels to overlap — the first one sets the cell height
options.[data-fx-part=pair][data-key=n]: Paired image that changes with panel n (anywhere outside the panel)
options.interval: Time until the next slide (ms), default 5200 — 0 means no auto-advance
options.shift: Distance (%) the incoming panel steps aside, default 4 — 0 means it just overlaps in place
options.click: next: Click the stage to go to the next panel
options.fx:change / fx:go: On change the element emits fx:change(detail.index), and sending fx:go(detail.index) to the element jumps to that panel. Use it when syncing with a preview row
